toolsPreview.name: get_global_gdp
toolsPreview.description: Get global GDP and macroeconomic indicators from the IMF World Economic Outlook. Supports GDP growth, inflation, government debt, current account, and GDP per capita for major economies.

toolsPreview.name: get_world_bank_data
toolsPreview.description: Get development indicators from the World Bank for major countries. Covers GDP, population, inflation, unemployment, GDP per capita, and Gini index.

toolsPreview.name: get_oecd_indicators
toolsPreview.description: Get OECD country comparison data for G7 and major economies. Topics: interest_rates (long-term), trade_balance (current account), cpi (inflation).
